final_claim: For \(\alpha(a)=(a,247/250-a,3/500,3/500)\), \(9/10\le a<19/20\), and \(\beta=(19/20,3/100,1/50,0)\), deterministic LOCC conversion with \(N\) copies of \(\alpha(a)\) used as its own catalyst requires \(N\ge 40a/((19-20a)(247-250a))\); this lower bound diverges like \(1/(5(19/20-a))\), and at the five source-table values \(a=0.900,0.908,0.918,0.925,0.928\) its ceiling gives the exact minimum copy counts \(2,3,4,5,6\).
limitations: The continuous formula is a necessary bound, not a sufficiency theorem away from the five tabulated parameters.
